### A New Year's Prayer for You
Author: Wendy Blight
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/a-new-year-s-prayer-for-you-encouragement-for-today-january-1-2015.html
Passage: 1 John 5:14
Points:
- Believers can approach God with bold confidence knowing He intimately created and understands each person.
- Effective prayer requires subduing selfish pride and willingly aligning one's desires with God's will.
- Petitions to God should seek spiritual discernment and truth to guard against worldly deception.
- Bringing fears honestly before the Lord replaces anxiety with supernatural peace and reassurance.
- Praying according to God's purpose enables believers to fulfill the good works He has prepared for them.
